data.name: Aktarun
data.gender_notes: Aktarun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aktarun means 'Little Star'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'aktar', which means 'more' or 'abundant'. The suffix '-un' is added to denote the feminine gender. The name is often given to babies born during the night or under the influence of the moon. The name Aktarun carries the meaning “Little Star” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aktarun usually hope their child will grow to embody little star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
